## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care completed 54 captures during January 2020. Activity was delivered through the site’s planned session arrangements, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity indicates that image capture proceeded across the month without any reported disruption beyond this routine staffing consideration. The total of 54 captures provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 54 captures, 2 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.7 per cent. The result identifies a small proportion of images that could not proceed through grading and should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for the month. The remaining captures were available for grading.

## Grading

Grading identified 6 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. Taken together, these results summarise the service activity, image quality and grading performance recorded at Oakridge Primary Care for January 2020.
